title: Tensor pullback of kernel ideals under an ambient isomorphism
statement: Let i₁:Z→Z₁ and i₂:Z→Z₂ be closed immersions of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], and let φ:Z₁→Z₂ be an isomorphism such that i₁≫φ=i₂. Put Iⱼ=ker(O_{Zⱼ}→(iⱼ)_*O_Z) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and Mⱼ=iⱼ*Iⱼ using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let ηⱼ:Iⱼ→(iⱼ)_*Mⱼ be the normalized tensor pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], sending a local section to its pure tensor with 1. There exists an O_Z-module isomorphism e:M₂≅M₁ such that for every open U⊆Z₂, sections s₂∈I₂(U), s₁∈I₁(φ⁻¹U) whose structure-sheaf images satisfy ι₁(s₁)=φ♯(ι₂(s₂)), and every open W⊆Z with W⊆i₂⁻¹U and W⊆i₁⁻¹(φ⁻¹U), one has e_W(η₂,U(s₂)|_W)=η₁,φ⁻¹U(s₁)|_W. No uniqueness assertion is included in this lemma.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01R3 and 01R4, specialized to a common closed subscheme and an ambient isomorphism; Sheaves, Lemma 0096

proof.text: Define β_U:I₂(U)→I₁(φ⁻¹U) by mapping the structure-sheaf image along φ.app U and taking its unique lift through the injective kernel inclusion. The equation i₁≫φ=i₂ shows it vanishes under i₁.app. Injectivity of the kernel inclusion proves additivity, semilinearity, and restriction compatibility, so these maps define β:I₂→φ_*I₁.

Compose β with φ_*η₁ and transport φ_*i₁_*M₁ to i₂_*M₁ using pushforward composition and hc. Under the normalized i₂ pullback adjunction this gives a map M₂→M₁. The unit equation yields the section formula on i₂⁻¹U=i₁⁻¹φ⁻¹U. Naturality yields it after both restrictions to W; uniqueness of ideal section lifts identifies the prescribed s₁ with β_U(s₂).

Repeat with inv φ and i₂≫inv φ=i₁. The two kernel-section maps compose to identities because φ and inv φ induce inverse ring-sheaf maps. Both composites of the adjoint module maps therefore fix every pullback-unit section. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection shows the composites are identities, giving the required module isomorphism.

theorem exists_kernelTensorPullbackIso {Z Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    (i₁ : Z ⟶ Z₁) (i₂ : Z ⟶ Z₂) [IsClosedImmersion i₁] [IsClosedImmersion i₂]
    (φ : Z₁ ⟶ Z₂) [IsIso φ] (hc : i₁ ≫ φ = i₂) :
    ∃ e : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₂).obj i₂.ker.toModules ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₁).obj i₁.ker.toModules,
          ∀ (U : Z₂.Opens) (s₂ : Γ(i₂.ker.toModules, U))
            (s₁ : Γ(i₁.ker.toModules, φ ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
            i₁.ker.toModulesι.app (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) s₁ =
              φ.app U (i₂.ker.toModulesι.app U s₂) →
            ∀ (W : Z.Opens) (a : W ≤ i₂ ⁻¹ᵁ U) (b : W ≤ i₁ ⁻¹ᵁ (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U)),
              e.hom.app W
                  (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₂).obj i₂.ker.toModules).val.map (homOfLE a).op
                    (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                      i₂)).unit.app i₂.ker.toModules).app U s₂)) =
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i₁).obj i₁.ker.toModules).val.map (homOfLE b).op
                  (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                    i₁)).unit.app i₁.ker.toModules).app (φ ⁻¹ᵁ U) s₁)
